title: check_message_digest returns SignatureVerification for digest mismatch
description: verify.rs check_message_digest line 303: when the content hash does not match the messageDigest attribute, it returns SmimeError::SignatureVerification. The signature has NOT been verified yet at this point (Step 3 in verify_one). Returning SignatureVerification here causes the SignerResult.error to say 'signature verification failed' when the actual problem is a message-digest mismatch — a different failure mode. A caller diagnosing a tampered message vs. a forged signature cannot distinguish these. Should return a dedicated error, e.g. SmimeError::MalformedInput("message digest mismatch") or a new variant.
close_reason: Fixed: check_message_digest now returns Other('message digest mismatch') instead of SignatureVerification, giving callers a distinct error string
